**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The white tray is roughly rectangular with a width of about 20 cm, so I treat it as a side plate. Area ≈ 3.14 × (10)² ≈ 314 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** One item: asparagus spears (about 6 to 7 spears, roughly 1 cm thick, some with woody ends). No oil or sauce is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Asparagus covers about 12% of the tray (≈ 38 cm²).

**STEP 5 - Volume:** The spears lie flat, so the height is about 1 cm. Volume ≈ 38 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 38 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Cut vegetables have a bulk density of about 0.6 g/ml. Weight ≈ 38 ml × 0.6 ≈ 23 g. Visible spear length (about 110 cm total at ~1 cm diameter) suggests a somewhat higher mass, so I round up to about 40 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Cooked asparagus is about 20 kcal/100 g. 40 g × 20 kcal/100 g ≈ 8 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A few spears on a side plate should weigh tens of grams, and about 40 g with ~8 kcal fits what's visible. Estimates are approximate, since spear mass depends on how they were cooked and their exact length.

**Estimate:** about 40 g of asparagus, about 8 kcal.
